name: io.github.mamertofabian/mcp-everything-search
title: Everything Search
description: Fast file search: Everything SDK on Windows, Spotlight (mdfind) on macOS, locate/plocate on Linux.

environmentVariables.name: EVERYTHING_SDK_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Windows only (required there): full path to Everything64.dll from the Everything SDK

environmentVariables.name: EVERYTHING_SEARCH_TOOL_NAME
environmentVariables.description: Optional tool name (letters, digits, _ and -, 1-64 chars) if 'search' collides with another server
